# Copilot Repository Instructions — Chronicle

All agent and contributor instructions live in one place: [`/CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) at the repository root (single source of truth per backlog decision D10/D12).

Read it before making changes. It contains the verify loop, project snapshot, module map, conventions, gotchas, definition of done, and the never-touch list.

Path-specific note for `docs/`: see the "Docs & decisions" section of `CLAUDE.md` — docs are updated in the same PR as the behavior they describe.
